name: KDocs
description: Connect KDocs (WPS Cloud Documents) to create, read, edit, organize, and collaborate on documents, spreadsheets, PDFs, presentations, and knowledge bases.
authorization.title: Authorize KDocs
authorization.description: Open the KDocs website, copy a Token from the dedicated integration entry, and paste it here. The Token is encrypted and used only for the official KDocs MCP service.
authorization.token.label: WPS Token
authorization.token.description: User Token for the official KDocs MCP service.
capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.documents.title: Documents and files
capabilities.documents.description: Create, read, upload, search, share, move, and export cloud documents.
capabilities.spreadsheets.title: Spreadsheets and presentations
capabilities.spreadsheets.description: Work with Excel, smart sheets, PDFs, online text documents, and presentations.
capabilities.knowledge.title: Knowledge and workflows
capabilities.knowledge.description: Manage knowledge bases, clip web pages, organize content, and run common workflows.
capabilities.safety.title: Safety controls
capabilities.safety.description: Search the tool catalog; sensitive writes, deletion, and unknown effects require confirmation. Writes are never retried automatically.
examples.title: Examples
examples.report.title: Write a work report
examples.report.description: Extract information from existing documents and create weekly, daily, or summary reports.
examples.table.title: Process spreadsheet data
examples.table.description: Create collection forms, update data, and configure validation, filters, and protection rules.
examples.knowledge.title: Organize knowledge
examples.knowledge.description: Search files, read content, and archive materials in a KDocs knowledge base.
